traversal: EVERY referenced type plus explicit defnInfo/thmInfo/opaqueInfo value and inductive constructors; no namespace/external pruning, allowlist, or depth cutoff
selection: ALL actual declarations defined in the assigned target module, including private/compiler-generated/constructors; no assumed root count
crosscheck: Independent full graph and installed Lean.CollectAxioms for EACH actual root, EACH defining-module union, and combined union
